actions_or_findings.title: NON_BLOCKING LOCALAI4B-N2 — resource evidence compares deployment candidates, not parameter count alone
actions_or_findings.trigger: Making model-size, memory, latency or production-capacity conclusions.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The actual candidates differ in both size and quantization: 2B tag reports 2.3B/Q8_0 and 2,741,192,820 bytes; 4B reports 4.7B/Q4_K_M and 3,389,983,735 bytes. The 4B text run took 12.718 seconds with sampled minimum free RAM 13,543 MiB and GPU free 10,465 MiB. These are whole-workstation samples under a different baseline, not model-exclusive allocation or a controlled 2B-versus-4B benchmark. The 0.472-second red-image run has only its baseline sample, so it does not establish an in-flight memory peak.

actions_or_findings.title: RELEASE_BLOCKER LOCALAI-R-PROXY — diagnostic proxy isolation does not establish API/Worker proxy isolation
actions_or_findings.trigger: Extending the diagnostic's no-inherited-proxy guarantee to business runtime or real resident data.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The reviewed 4B text client explicitly uses trust_env=False; image/metadata/download-loopback helpers use ProxyHandler({}). Thus this diagnostic avoids inherited environment proxies. The shared production-provider HTTP helper still constructs a default httpx.Client, and the reviewed launcher does not establish equivalent isolation. No actual proxy leakage was observed or inferred. Verify or explicitly constrain that runtime boundary before broader business/real-data acceptance; it does not block the already-isolated read-only probes.

actions_or_findings.title: RELEASE_BLOCKER LOCALAI-R-QUALITY — image calibration, real inference and production acceptance remain distinct
actions_or_findings.trigger: Claiming repair-photo understanding, real multimodal automatic dispatch, real RAG or production readiness.
actions_or_findings.rationale: I opened both PNGs and verified their recorded hashes. They are plain blue/red calibration images, correctly distinguished by the real 4B responses in 3.375 and 0.472 seconds. This establishes a bounded image-input/output path, not appliance/fault recognition, image-versus-text contradiction handling or the application's full VLM/Worker business path. Real bge-m3/RAG, speech, production throughput, security, providers and release remain unaccepted.

This is explicitly NOT a PASS for the whole SELFHOST-AI-LOCAL-001 task, actual automatic dispatch, slice 023, model-quality acceptance or Production V1.
